claims.claim: Poland's defence minister said two missiles and a jet-powered drone fell on Polish territory during Russia's overnight attack on November 20, at Nowy Lipowiec, Rudnik nad Sanem, and Molodycz.
claims.episode_span: two missiles and a jet-powered drone came down in the country's southeast
claims.source_title: Russian missiles hit Poland: What happened, and could NATO respond?
claims.supporting_quote: Poland’s Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz told a news conference in Warsaw that two missiles and a jet-powered drone fell on Polish territory during Russia’s overnight attack on November 20. The missiles came down at Nowy Lipowiec and Rudnik nad Sanem, while the jet-powered drone fell at Molodycz, all in the country’s southeast.

claims.claim: No immediate injuries or damage were reported from the impacts in Poland.
claims.episode_span: No immediate injuries or damage were reported.
claims.source_title: Russian missiles hit Poland: What happened, and could NATO respond?
claims.supporting_quote: No immediate injuries or damage were reported.

claims.claim: One missile is believed to have crashed about 35 kilometres from European troops' exercises; a Kh-101 went down about 50 kilometres from the Ukrainian border; a jet-powered drone hit about 30 kilometres from the border.
claims.episode_span: One missile is believed to have crashed about 35 kilometres, or 22 miles, from where European troops were exercising.
claims.source_title: Russian missiles hit Poland: What happened, and could NATO respond?
claims.supporting_quote: One missile is believed to have crashed about 35km (22 miles) from where European troops’ military exercises were taking place. A Kh-101 cruise missile went down about 50km (31 miles) from the Ukrainian border, and what officials believe was a jet-powered drone hit about 30km (20 miles) from the border.

claims.claim: Zelenskyy said Russia fired more than 400 drones and at least 110 missiles that night, including 27 ballistic missiles, and that at least eight civilians were killed and more than two dozen wounded.
claims.episode_span: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia fired more than 400 drones and at least 110 missiles
claims.source_title: Russian missiles hit Poland: What happened, and could NATO respond?
claims.supporting_quote: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia fired more than 400 drones and at least 110 missiles, including 27 ballistic missiles, some with cluster warheads. At least eight civilians were killed and more than two dozen were wounded.

claims.claim: Donald Tusk said it appeared Poland was dealing with an intentional provocation by Russia, likely timed to coincide with European military exercises that began on November 9.
claims.episode_span: Prime Minister Donald Tusk said it appeared "we are dealing with an intentional provocation" by Russia.
claims.source_title: Russian missiles hit Poland: What happened, and could NATO respond?
claims.supporting_quote: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said it appeared “we are dealing with an intentional provocation” by Russia. He said the incident was likely timed to coincide with the European military exercises in Poland. The unprecedented two-week exercise began on November 9 in southeastern Poland

claims.claim: Denmark's PET said it stopped individuals intending to kill a person named by Danish media as rapper Kyivstoner, and two people charged with attempted murder and assisting a foreign intelligence service pleaded not guilty.
claims.episode_span: Two people have been charged with attempted murder and with assisting a foreign intelligence service, and both pleaded not guilty.
claims.source_title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
claims.supporting_quote: Denmark's security and intelligence agency (PET) said it had stopped individuals who were intending to kill the person, named by Danish media as rapper Kyivstoner, at a concert in September. Two people were charged with attempted murder and assisting a foreign intelligence service, and pleaded not guilty.

claims.claim: Three individuals were stopped near the venue on 25 September with firearms and knives, and PET linked them to the banned gang Loyal to Familia.
claims.episode_span: Three individuals were stopped in a car near the venue on 25 September.
claims.source_title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
claims.supporting_quote: PET said three individuals were stopped while travelling by car near the music venue where Kyivstoner was set to perform on 25 September. Firearms and knives were found in the vehicle, PET said.

claims.claim: Denmark wants the EU to halt tourist visas for Russian citizens and not recognise Russian non-biometric passports, and will present proposals to EU ambassadors on Monday.
claims.episode_span: Denmark would present the proposals to EU ambassadors in Brussels on Monday.
claims.source_title: 'Unacceptable': EU chief condemns alleged Russian plot to kill US-Ukrainian citizen
claims.supporting_quote: The message seen by Reuters, and sent on Friday evening to senior European diplomats, said the bloc should impose further restrictions on Russian nationals' access to the Schengen zone, including a halt to tourist visas for Russian citizens and a Schengen-wide policy of non-recognition of Russian non-biometric passports, according to the message. Denmark would present its proposals at a meeting of EU ambassadors in Brussels on Monday.

claims.claim: The Russian embassy in Copenhagen said the accusations were not backed with proof.
claims.episode_span: The embassy said on Friday the accusations were not backed with proof.
claims.source_title: 'Unacceptable': EU chief condemns alleged Russian plot to kill US-Ukrainian citizen
claims.supporting_quote: The Russian embassy in Copenhagen said on Friday the accusations were not backed with proof.

claims.source_title: Ukraine Springs “Bear Trap” on Russian Forces, Liberating 14 Villages and 200 Sq. Km
claims.supporting_quote: Ukrainian forces have liberated 14 settlements and reclaimed nearly 200 square kilometers (77 square miles) of territory in the Kharkiv region during a counteroffensive codenamed “Bear Trap,”
